Customer Request System

One form for complete part details

Customers can send a clean WhatsApp request with vehicle, part, quantity, buyer type and warranty preference. No stock is claimed until the team confirms availability.

Warranty note: Warranty options may be available depending on the product. Confirm coverage and terms before purchase.

Fast request tips

For quicker confirmation, include vehicle model, year, part name, part number if available, quantity and delivery city.

Parts & Categories

High-demand parts customers can request

Each category is designed around “check availability” to avoid false stock claims while still making the customer journey fast.

Popular Requests

Common parts customers ask for

These are quick-request shortcuts only. Availability, condition, price and warranty will be confirmed by the team before purchase.

Send Correct Details

Help us find the exact part faster

Auto parts depend on model, year, engine/chassis code and sometimes left/right side. Sending complete information reduces delay and wrong-match risk.

Tip: If you have a photo of the old part, part number or chassis plate, send it manually on WhatsApp after the message opens.
🚗Vehicle details

Make, model, year and variant if known.

🔢Part number / code

Part number, engine code or chassis code if visible.

↔Side or position

Left/right, front/rear, driver/passenger side if relevant.

📦Quantity and condition

Retail, wholesale, new/used/budget option and warranty preference.
